description: STORY: build a whole short from one JSON document (aes.story/1; read studio_guide {topic:"story"} first). Generated title, counter, terminal, chips and end-card scenes plus your footage, timed in BEATS so every cut lands on the music grid; sfx, drops and on-screen text can hang on scene events. {story, dryRun:true} validates and returns the beat schedule, events and warnings (reading time, short shots, drops off the bar) without rendering. Without dryRun it starts a build and returns {buildId}; poll {action:"status", buildId} until done: result has projectId, revision and the renderFormat to give studio_render. The result is an ordinary project (edit it with studio_edit). Unchanged generated scenes are reused when you build again.
